subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should OpenClaw support Browserbase Sessions API as a first-party browser driver now, route it through a generic browser-backend/plugin seam, or document the static Browserbase URL as unsupported until that seam exists?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent shape changes credential, session-state, and provider-specific browser behavior that repo policy treats as compatibility and product-sensitive.

options.title: Revise and land Browserbase driver
options.body: Use PR #83306 or a follow-up to add Browserbase Sessions API support after security review, live proof, redaction, cleanup, and config/credential contract decisions are complete.

options.title: Design generic backend seam first
options.body: Keep this issue open under the broader pluggable browser-backend work and avoid first-party Browserbase-specific config until the extension API is settled.

options.title: Document unsupported for now
options.body: Remove or qualify the static Browserbase setup docs and close the implementation path unless maintainers want Browserbase-specific support in core.

recommendation.title: Revise and land Browserbase driver
recommendation.body: Use PR #83306 or a follow-up to add Browserbase Sessions API support after security review, live proof, redaction, cleanup, and config/credential contract decisions are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the direct WebSocket Browserbase path and have recent browser runtime/plugin-boundary history relevant to the first-party versus plugin-seam decision.
